reasoning: 驗證目標：preset 按鍵被持續按住超過兩秒時，HU 觸發 Preset Save 功能。關鍵情境條件：按住時間相對於兩秒門檻的位置。為什麼這樣切：條文給出明確的數值門檻，依 §8.3 以 boundary 為軸拆兩條——門檻上方觸發儲存、門檻下方不觸發儲存；只驗超過兩秒的一側，會讓「任何按壓都儲存」的實作通過測試（§7），而該實作會在使用者每次選台時覆蓋 preset。刻意略過：兩秒以下按壓走 Preset Select 的結果由 033 覆蓋，本 leaf 的 ER 只驗「未觸發儲存」這個本條文的否定面；儲存的內容與非揮發性由 037 覆蓋。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 036-01 以超過兩秒的按住驗證 Preset Save 被觸發；036-02 以未達兩秒的按住驗證 Preset Save 未被觸發、preset 內容不變

tcs.tc_title: Hold beyond two seconds triggers Preset Save
tcs.test_item: HU shall trigger Preset Save function when HU identifies a preset button being pressed and held continously for more than two seconds
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode and tuned to a receivable station
4. Preset 8 is set to a station on a frequency other than the currently tuned one
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the currently tuned frequency and the content of preset 8
2. Press and hold the preset 8 button continuously for 3 seconds
3. Release the preset 8 button
4. Read the content of preset 8
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned frequency is displayed and preset 8 holds its previous station
2. The Preset Save function is triggered while the button is held
3. The button release ends the request
4. Preset 8 holds the frequency tuned in step 1
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)

tcs.tc_title: Hold shorter than two seconds does not trigger Preset Save
tcs.test_item:
HU shall trigger Preset Save function when HU identifies a preset button being pressed and held continously for more than two seconds

(Below the two second threshold — Preset Save not triggered)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode and tuned to a receivable station
4. Preset 9 is set to a station on a frequency other than the currently tuned one
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the currently tuned frequency and the content of preset 9
2. Press and hold the preset 9 button continuously for 1 second
3. Release the preset 9 button
4. Read the content of preset 9
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned frequency is displayed and preset 9 holds its previous station
2. The Preset Save function is not triggered
3. The button release ends the request
4. Preset 9 still holds the station it held in step 1, and the frequency tuned in step 1 is not stored to it
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
